answer_4.quote: An author annotated all atoms that survived pruning as either invalid or Premise (P) Hypothesis (H) Update (U) Atoms ... An external annotator also annotated a sample of 100 atoms for validity ... The author annotated all valid atomic sub‑problems according to the five‑point scale ranging from strongly weakens (-2) to strongly strengthens (+2).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judged each atom for validity (valid/invalid) and assigned a strength label on a -2 to +2 scale.
